{{Top|leg}}
'''Petroleum''' was a naturally occurring type of [[Oil/Legends|oil]] that could be used in the production of [[Plastic/Legends|plastics]]. The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Manpha/Legends|Manpha]] had natural petroleum deposits that boiled up from its swamps. The native [[Shawda Ubb/Legends|Shawda Ubb]] collected the oil and shipped it to their capital [[City/Legends|city]], [[Shanpan]], where it was processed into plastics for export throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
